note.zh: 在 2810 中，友善帝国可建立联络（a → 2815）或被动观测（b → 2830）；仅限“野蛮掠夺者”公民的“索要赎金”（c）和狂暴灭绝者的“告诉他们末日来了”（d）同样进入 2815；不友善帝国只有“静观灾难扩散”（e → 2830）。
note.en: In 2810 a non-unfriendly empire may establish contact (a → 2815) or observe passively (b → 2830); “Demand ransom” (c, Barbaric Despoilers civic) and “Inform them their doom has come” (d, homicidal) also lead to 2815; unfriendly empires only get “Watch the destruction unfold” (e → 2830).

label.zh: 修复轨道、摧毁卫星或撤离
label.en: Fix the orbit, destroy the moon or withdraw

note.zh: 2815：修复卫星轨道（仅非不友善帝国 → 2820 → 2835）、摧毁卫星（非和平主义且非亲异族 → 2825）、切断通讯（c 非不友善 / d 不友善，都进入 2830，难度 −2）。
note.en: 2815: fix the moon's orbit (non-unfriendly only → 2820 → 2835), destroy the moon (neither pacifist nor xenophile → 2825), cut communications (c non-unfriendly / d unfriendly, both → 2830, difficulty −2).

note.zh: 摧毁卫星之后：以浅冲击了结星球上的居民（2840）或部署遥测设施（2845，之后 3600 天地表气候崩溃，触发 2890）。
note.en: After destroying the moon: end the planet's suffering with a shallow impact (2840) or deploy remote research devices (2845, followed 3600 days later by the climate collapse event 2890).

note.zh: 该星球获得+10社会研究矿藏，大量星界丝缕与社会研究；不友善帝国另得凝聚力；探索结束。
note.en: The planet gains a +10 society deposit, a large astral thread reward and society research; unfriendly empires also get unity; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 大量星界丝缕与凝聚力；解锁一项潮汐锁定决议及相关矿藏条件；探索结束。
note.en: A large astral thread reward and unity; it enables a tidal-locking decision and a deposit condition; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 大量星界丝缕；解锁建造袖珍行星纪念碑的选项；探索结束。
note.en: A large astral thread reward; unlocks the option to build a Microplanet Memorial; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 该星球获得+15社会研究矿藏，并得到大量星界丝缕与社会研究；探索结束。约十年后该矿藏消失。
note.en: The planet gains a +15 society deposit, a large astral thread reward and society research; the exploration ends. About ten years later the deposit is lost.

note.zh: 极端气候使数据来源中断，+15社会研究矿藏被移除。
note.en: Extreme climate shifts end the data stream, and the +15 society deposit is removed.

notes.zh: 抽取权重 1，无条件；不产出遗珍，没有失败分支（00_astral_rifts.txt:366-375）。
notes.en: Draw weight 1, no conditions; no relic and no failure branch (00_astral_rifts.txt:366-375).

notes.zh: 2810 的正文有三种变体：默认、野蛮掠夺者公民、狂暴灭绝者。选项由“是否不友善”“是否狂暴灭绝”“是否有野蛮掠夺者公民”决定。
notes.en: The text of 2810 has three variants: default, Barbaric Despoilers civic and homicidal. Options depend on is_unfriendly, is_homicidal and the Barbaric Despoilers civic.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 2800–2890 全部事件、选项条件与国家标记的下游用途。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 2800–2890 with option conditions and downstream use of the country flags.
